free_tier.stated: No free storage quota published; premium advertises 'Download files up to 200 GB' and bandwidth blocks up to 18 TB.

egress.terms: Free downloads are the usual XFileSharing throttled path; premium sells bandwidth blocks, so egress is the product.

tooling: Standard XFileSharing API surface (op=... query paths); JDownloader-supported.
chaining: Nothing free to multiply — the headline number (200 GB) is a *download* ceiling on a paid plan, not a per-file upload cap.
limits_note: Premium: 'Download files up to 200 GB', 90-day plan = 18 TB total bandwidth, $64.99. Free: no published storage or per-file number.
reliability_note: The site canonicalises katfile.com to katfile.co between requests, so links must tolerate the redirect. VPN connections are explicitly unsupported for download, which breaks IP-rotation strategies.

evidence.proved: 'Download files up to 200 GB', '90 Days ... 18 TB total bandwidth'
'How much storage do free accounts get?' is not answered; only generic hosting text
'Be aware that VPN connections for download is not supported'
